title: keel reference registry
description: The canonical registry of reference projects for the refresh discipline (P4, docs/00-mandate.md section 4), docs/reference-projects.yaml. One entry per reference project with its upstream, licence, licence class, whether the owner named it, the relative path of its local clone and the review history; plus the scouting record (standing GitHub queries, last run, candidates). The construct map in docs/16-sources-credits.md says what keel took; this registry says what was examined and when.
$comment: Not in the strict subset: the reason of a scouting candidate is optional. local_clone is a path relative to the repository root that must leave it (../); scripts/validate.mjs checks the shape and never opens the clone.

upstream.description: Public upstream URL (a repository, or an organisation when the project spans several), or null when there is no repository to pull (public documentation only).

licenceClass.description: oss: ideas may be re-implemented in keel's own words and code. source-available (for example ELv2): ideas only, no text, code, schema, prompt, template or file layout. proprietary: public documentation only. unverified: the licence has not been read from a licence file; treated as proprietary (ideas from public documentation only) until a refresh review reads it and records the class.

id.description: Registry id, for example openspec or keel-other.

display_name.description: Name as written in docs/00-mandate.md and docs/16-sources-credits.md; a parenthesis may add a disambiguator, for example keel-other (dcsg/keel).

licence.description: Licence as read from the clone or the public documentation, in words.

named_by_owner.description: true when the owner's statement names the project; such a project must be cross-referenced in docs/00-mandate.md and docs/16-sources-credits.md (validate --only references).

local_clone.description: Path of the local clone relative to the repository root, always outside it (starts with ../), or null when nothing is cloned. Never committed and never opened by scripts/validate.mjs.

role.description: What keel takes from the project, in one sentence.

reviewed.description: Review history, oldest first. Empty until the first refresh review reads the project.

review.description: One review pass. head is the clone HEAD that was read, never a claim about upstream.

head.description: Abbreviated commit id of the clone at review time, or null without a clone.

branch.description: Branch the clone was read on, recorded when it is not the upstream default branch; the next refresh review fetches and fast-forwards this branch.

version.description: Released version read at review time, or null when the project publishes none.

scope.description: What the pass covered, for example the M0 blueprint or a milestone exit review.

outcome.description: adopted: constructs entered keel. candidates: proposals await the owner. none: nothing new. declined: examined and rejected.

scouting.description: The GitHub scouting record of the refresh discipline (docs/00-mandate.md section 4.3).

last_run.description: Date of the last scouting run, or null before the first.

queries.description: Standing search queries, run verbatim at every refresh review.

candidate.description: A project found by scouting. The owner decides whether it is pulled locally and, after analysis, whether it is adopted into the registry.

status.description: proposed: reported to the owner. pulled: cloned locally for analysis. declined, deferred: the owner's decision. adopted: promoted to a project entry.

reason.description: Why the status was chosen; expected once the owner has decided.
